elements.label: Table 6.7
elements.title: Terminology Summarizing the Four Possibilities from a Confusion Matrix
elements.details:
|                      | Predicted Positive                  | Predicted Negative                      |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Actual Positive      | True Positive (TP) – hit           | False Negative (FN) – miss             |
| Actual Negative      | False Positive (FP) – false alarm  | True Negative (TN) – correctly rejected |
elements.summary: This table summarizes the four possible outcomes in a binary classification confusion matrix: true positive, false negative, false positive, and true negative, with their common interpretations.

elements.label: Figure 6.17
elements.title: Heatmap for Flower/Tree/Grass Example

details.notable: Main diagonal cells (23, 32, 18) are darkest indicating higher correct classification counts; off-diagonal cells show misclassifications, e.g., 12 grasses predicted as flowers.

elements.summary: This heatmap visualizes the confusion matrix for a model classifying images into flower, tree, or grass categories. Darker cells on the main diagonal indicate higher correct classification counts, while off-diagonal cells reveal misclassification rates, highlighting that grasses are often mistaken for flowers.
